answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the ferrous is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the onyx of a task receipt, and the wharf is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
